subject: literacy
concept: Identifying root words within longer words containing prefixes and/or suffixes
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading morphology sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student peels prefix/suffix tiles off a combined word to reveal the root word tile underneath
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the root word within a set of pictured prefixed/suffixed words
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the root word within a given complex word and states its meaning

misconception_flags: misidentifies part of the root as a prefix/suffix or vice versa

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
